boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Stevens spaces documented by the university for studying, gathering, lounging, or spending time outdoors.

cards.title: Samuel C. Williams Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library
cards.notes: Bring a project or reading list and use the library’s documented collaborative work and study spaces; check building access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A central campus library with research support, technology, and collaborative study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens says the Samuel C. Williams Library provides students research materials, technology, collaborative work and study spaces, and support services.
cards.source_title: Stevens’ Library Receives 2025 Library Excellence Award
cards.access_notes: Campus building access may vary; verify access requirements with Stevens before visiting.
